title: Transform
description: Change text without retyping it: case, numbers, joining lines, swapping and overwriting characters.

levels.title: Caps lock
levels.description: It's a constant now. Make the name SHOUT.
levels.hint: gU is the uppercase operator. Give it a text object.

levels.title: Version bump
levels.description: Ship the patch release: 1.9.9 becomes 1.9.10. It's not string math, and Vim knows it.
levels.hint: <C-a> adds one to the number under or after the cursor.

levels.title: Count me in
levels.description: Someone numbered this list lazily. Make it 1, 2, 3, 4.
levels.hint: Select lines 2 to 4 and press g<C-a>: each line goes up by one more than the line above.

levels.title: Join the club
levels.description: Join all three lines into one. The password must stay in one piece.

value: The password is hunter2, obviously. Don't tell anyone.

levels.hint: J joins lines with a space; gJ joins them without one.

levels.title: Teh typo
levels.description: Fix 'Teh' with as few keys as possible.
levels.hint: x deletes a character and p puts it back after the cursor: xp swaps two characters.

levels.title: Overwrite
levels.description: Approve it and bump the priority to 1, keeping the field width.
levels.hint: R types over existing text; r replaces a single character.
